title: Khaakar Sinaa Jo Seenay Pa Akbar Guzar Gaye
body:
Khaakar sinaa jo seenay pa Akbar guzar gaye
Boley Hussain aye mahey, Anwar kidhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Peeri mai ghar Hussain ka, barbaad kar gaye
Zakhm-e-jigar sey tum shafaq-e-khoon mai bhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham sey yeh haal hai ke, bahot beyqaraar hoon
Awaaz doh kay aan kay tumpar nisaar hoon
Khaakar sinaa jo seenay pa Akbar guzar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye zaalimoun ghareeb hoon, aur beydayaar hoon
Aray bhooley ho kyon, rasool ka main yaadgaar hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Lillah mujhpaa rahem karo, beyqaraar hoon
Aray beta jawaan margayaa, mai soghvaar hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir dekhloon us apney, saadath nashaan ko
Barchi kahaan lagi meray, kadyal jawaan ko
Khaakar sinaa jo seenay pa Akbar guzar gaye
